name: d01_noguard_accuracy_tie
purpose: Both sides bring Raichu with Raichunite Y (team A against team A) and Mega Evolve on turn 1: Raichu-Mega-Y has No Guard, so the Accuracy event of Focus Blast runs two No Guard handlers at one Speed and the reference draws their order (SPEED_TIE, context event:Accuracy). data/abilities.ts noguard: onAnyAccuracy returns true when its holder is the source or the target of the move and passes the accuracy on otherwise, so the order decides nothing and the converter drops the draw. Team preview and turn 1 of the case, cut after the turn with the tie. Found by the differential loop (A3, case fz_1_118 of seed 1, battle 118 of the run: team A against team A).
